title: Generate a number sequence
prompt: Using a recursive CTE, generate the sequence of integers from 1 to 5 as a column named n.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dummy13 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO dummy13 VALUES (1);
reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE counter(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM counter WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM counter;
